name: Stroop effect and attentional training: trial-level data
description: Teaching dataset, fictional, built for the seminar 'Hands-on Open Science' (University of Padua, 23 September 2026). Trial-level data from a colour Stroop task administered to adult participants assigned to an experimental group (four weeks of attentional training) or a control group. One row per trial. The data do not come from a real study and must not be used for scientific purposes.

affiliation.name: Dipartimento di Psicologia Generale, Universita di Padova

measurementTechnique: Colour Stroop task, computerised, presented with E-Prime 3.0
citation: Rossi, A., & Bianchi, L. (2026). Stroop effect and attentional training: trial-level data [Data set].
